source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Run Memory-Test via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r memory
3. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. The result of Memory-Test should be PASS without errors.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but incomplete; alternate syntax unverified, resource impact labeled read-only and source transitions omitted.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds workload/MIG isolation, memory scope, ECC/thermal baseline, syntax, restoration and recovery.

original_test_intent: Run the approved DCGM memory diagnostic on every target GPU, verify its complete tool result without memory/ECC/thermal errors, correlate system events, and preserve/restore persistence state.
original_method: Validate exact DCGM syntax, stable targets, workload/MIG blackout and memory/ECC/thermal baseline, execute source persistence enable plus verbose memory diagnostic under one approved plan, enforce Safety Stop, then restore approved persistence state.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the fixed diagnostic, safety and restoration plan. Commands, telemetry and Safety Stop enforcement are machine-executable; approval does not make the core PARTIAL.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi, driver and stable GPU target map
Installed-tool proof for source `-v -r memory` or equivalent syntax/coverage
GPU memory/free capacity, ECC, temperature, MIG/workload baseline
Memory coverage, timeout and thermal/ECC/driver Safety Stop policy
Persistence baseline/final state, OOB/recovery and plan approval
safety_requirements: Quiesce protected workloads/MIG clients and verify memory/thermal headroom before the diagnostic.
One approval covers only the unchanged plan; stop on syntax/target deviation, insufficient memory, timeout, thermal/ECC/driver fault or device loss.
Preserve raw counters/events and full stdout/stderr/return code; do not clear ECC counters or hide failures.
No automatic retry, GPU reset, workload termination, service/driver restart or alternate command guess.
Restore only the approved final persistence state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate tools/syntax, target/resource baseline, blackout, safety and recovery gates.
Execute persistence enable and exact verbose memory diagnostic with live memory/ECC/thermal evidence.
Apply Safety Stop, restore approved final state, correlate post OS/BMC/driver events and report Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Approve syntax, targets, blackout, memory/ECC/thermal policy, full plan and restoration.
Decide disposition after partial result or Safety Stop.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `--memory` may be version-specific but is not proven equivalent to source `-v -r memory`; it omits persistence and understates memory resource impact.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve source syntax and both persistence steps; use an alternate only with versioned documentation and equivalent memory-test/verbosity coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both persistence transitions, verbose memory run, criterion, script URL and 2/2-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE MEMORY TEST RETAINED WITH SAFETY ENVELOPE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a stable per-GPU/DCGM-ID transaction with exclusive resource checks, memory/ECC/thermal baseline/live limits, full diagnostic, event correlation and approved restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCGM-supported GPUs eligible for the deployed memory diagnostic.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, MIG mode, nvidia-smi, OS/kernel, BMC and workload runtime.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics documentation for the deployed release and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds syntax proof, stable identity, resource/safety and restoration controls without reducing the source memory test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Memory coverage and Safety Stop policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A short source runtime may not equal exhaustive memory coverage; the exact DCGM plugin scope must be reported.

project_override_considerations: Projects may set target GPUs, timeout, coverage and limits. The report must state actual plugin parameters/coverage and cannot claim broader memory coverage than executed.
expected_evidence: DCGM/driver versions, stable GPU/MIG/memory/ECC/thermal/workload baseline and approval
Exact syntax proof and complete persistence-enable output
Full verbose memory diagnostic, return code, runtime/resource scope and live telemetry
Safety-stop record if any, post events and approved restoration

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires the DCGM memory test and PASS; the DeepSeek syntax difference is historical applicability, not a master contradiction.

review_improvement: Prevents a resource-consuming memory diagnostic from being run as a harmless query or accepted without ECC/thermal and final-state evidence.
